subject: MAP: HelixAI capacity alignment & acceptance lane
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya@helixai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP proposal + capacity ask

Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HelixAI is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our retrieval-augmented generation workflows. Procurement asked me to put a short MAP in writing so we can align on timing and capacity needs. High level asks from our side: 

- Target go-live: Q4 ramp starting 2026-11-15 with full production by 2026-12-15.
- Peak traffic estimate: ~2.5M generated tokens/day (spikey during business hours).
- Model requirements: H100-class nodes preferred; we'd like to understand pool sizing to sustain 250 concurrent streams at p90 latency < 350ms.
- Must pass SOC2 evidence checks and provide per-token billing and tracing for first 90 days.

Can you share a MAP draft with lead-time assumptions (Dedicated vs Private), recommended GPU pool sizing, and any acceptance / cutover milestones? Procurement and infra will weigh in on the lead times — copying Ben to help with sizing.

Thanks,
Priya Reddy
Director, Platform Engineering | HelixAI
[Procurement: procurement@helixai.com]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@helixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP proposal + capacity ask

Hi Priya — appreciate the clear asks. Attaching a working MAP workbook (v0.3) that lays out: Dedicated vs Private lead times, recommended pool sizing scenarios (conservative / target / aggressive), and a proposed acceptance lane with gating criteria.

Key summary here:
- Recommended starting pool (target scenario): 16x H100s (24GB) with auto-burst headroom to +4 units. This should cover 250 concurrent streams with our batching/KV-cache optimizations, p90 token latency target assumed at 300-350ms with 1024 token context.
- Dedicated lead time (reservation to capacity ready): 6-8 weeks (depends on tranche availability in the region).
- Private (on-prem/VPC) lead time: 10-14 weeks including network provisioning and KMS onboarding.
- Acceptance gates: perf smoke test (synthetic 72h), SOC2 evidence handoff, and a 48h live traffic soak at 50% of target QPS pre-cutover.

Attachments: [Attachment: HelixAI_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (xlsx, 64KB)]

Ben and Marissa — please confirm sizing assumptions below and add procurement/cost notes so I can circulate to Priya.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HelixAI_MAP_v0.3.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP proposal + capacity ask

Jasmine — looked through v0.3. A few notes on sizing and ops: 

- 16x H100s (24GB) is reasonable as a target if Helix can accept dynamic batching up to 256 and prefix caching for steady-state queries. If Helix's per-request context balloons beyond 1k tokens, we'd need an extra 4-6 cards; call this the "aggressive" scenario (20-22x H100).
- For the 250 concurrent streams, we model with 8-token average generated tokens per step and a 1.8x retries/overhead factor. Under those assumptions 16 H100s -> sustained throughput roughly 2.6M gen tokens/day with p90 ~320ms (measured in our sandbox).
- Ops caution: initial 72h synthetic smoke should include a KV cache warmup period (24h) to avoid skewed perf numbers. Recommend scheduling the smoke at least 48h before the live 48h soak.

I attached a short lead-time digest we maintain with partners — shows typical procurement windows and recent Q4 stock constraints.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hw_lead_times_Q4_2026.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@helixai.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP proposal + capacity ask

Priya / Team — following up from a commercial/ops perspective so timelines are actionable. Key commercial points for the MAP timeline: 

- Proposed commitment: initial 6-month Dedicated commitment for the target scenario (16x H100), with a 30-day notice to scale + an optional staged tranche (+4 units) mid-Q1 if metrics show sustained traffic.
- Procurement lead times: if Helix signs the term sheet by 2026-10-06, we can target capacity available for staging by 2026-11-15 (conservative path). Private/on-prem will push the staging date to ~2026-12-01.
- Discounting and credit: Sales can offer a one-time ramp credit for the first 60 days contingent on a signed MAP and SOC2 handoff. I'll queue pricing and formal term sheet. 

Next actions: 
1) Priya — confirm preferred commitment length and whether Dedicated vs Private is required.
2) Jasmine / Ben — finalize the acceptance checklist in the MAP workbook and confirm the synthetic test plan dates.
3) Marissa / Mina — legal & finance review: I'll drop a formal term sheet and an estimated ARR stamp.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Reddy <priya@helixai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP proposal + capacity ask

Thanks everyone — this is helpful and close to what we need. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Helix prefers Dedicated for the first 6 months. We accept the target sizing (16x H100) with an understanding of a +4 burst tranche if utilization trends higher.
- We can sign the term sheet by 2026-10-04. Please send the term sheet and the SOC2 evidence checklist.
- For the acceptance lane: we agree to the smoke/soak sequence Jasmine proposed. Can we target the synthetic smoke window 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-10 and the 48h live soak 2026-11-13 to 2026-11-15? That would let us cut over by ~2026-11-22.

Attaching a scanned sign-off for internal procurement (pre-sig) — we'll follow with a signed DocuSign once Redwood sends the term sheet.

Thanks — Priya
